title: Regular rotation and low turbulence in a diverse sample of z ∼ 4.5 galaxies observed with ALMA
question: What are the gas kinematics, rotation velocities, velocity dispersions, V/sigma ratios, and disc geometries of a diverse sample of highly resolved z ~ 4.5 galaxies observed in [CII] 158 um with ALMA?

what.value: CO(J=4-3), CO(J=2-1), and CO(J=5-4) luminosities and SFRs for AzTEC1, BRI1335-0417, J081740, and SGP38326

evidence.quote: For AzTEC 1, BRI1335-0417, SGP38326 (both galaxies), we use the J $= 4-3$, $2-1$ and $5-4$ transitions from (cite: yun15; jones16; oteo16), respectively.
For AzTEC 1, BRI1335-0417, SGP38326 (both galaxies), we use the J $= 4-3$, $2-1$ and $5-4$ transitions from (cite: yun15; jones16; oteo16), respectively.

what.value: Simulated mergers and discs from ALMA mock observations of SERRA simulation for PVsplit comparison

evidence.quote: We compare our galaxies with simulated galaxies known to be mergers or discs taken from (cite: rizzo22).
These are ALMA mock observations of galaxies from the `SERRA` simulation (cite: pallottini22).

what.value: Nine local disc galaxies and nine mergers from the WHISP survey for PVsplit comparison

evidence.quote: We also show nine randomly selected local disc galaxies from the WHISP survey (cite: vanderhulst01).

From the same survey we show nine mergers, minor and major, that have been classified as mergers by both the presence of companions in the datacubes (cite: swaters02; noordermeer05) and HI morphology (cite: holwerda11).

what.value: Literature compilation of velocity dispersions and V/sigma at z ~ 4-5 and in the Local Universe

evidence.quote: We see that our sample is similar to other galaxies with dynamically cold discs at similar redshift (cite: hodge12; rizzo20; rizzo21; lelli21).
Additionally, we can see a significant evolution in velocity dispersions when compared to HI and CO measurements of Local Universe spiral galaxies (cite: bacchini19; bacchini20).

recipe.goal: Search archive, calibrate visibilities, and image [CII] cubes and dust continuum
recipe.method: Query ALMA archive with astroquery and cross-reference with NED; calibrate raw visibilities with original archival scripts in CASA; concatenate two SGP38326 datasets with split and concat; subtract continuum with uvcontsub (linear) or imcontsub; image continuum (MFS) and line cubes with tclean down to 3x RMS (or 1.5x RMS for SGP38326)
key_parameters: Cleaning threshold: 3x RMS (AzTEC1, BRI1335-0417, J081740), 1.5x RMS (SGP38326)
Briggs robust = 2 (cubes: AzTEC1, J081740, SGP38326; continuum: J081740, SGP38326) and robust = 0.5 (cube: BRI1335-0417; continuum: AzTEC1, BRI1335-0417)
Cell size: 0.02"/px (AzTEC1, SGP38326), 0.03"/px (BRI1335-0417, J081740); uvtaper: 0.1" for SGP38326

recipe.goal: Create 3D source masks, integrated [CII] intensity maps, and pseudo 4-sigma contours
recipe.method: Run 3D source finder SEARCH in 3DBAROLO using SNRCUT and GROWTHCUT to mask cubes and collapse velocity channels into total intensity maps; use CANNUBI to compute pixel-by-pixel SNR maps and define pseudo 4-sigma contours (NT = 4); search SGP38326 cube to confirm companion emitters SGP38326-3 and SGP38326-4

recipe.goal: Generate mock galaxy cubes and validate CANNUBI disc geometry recovery
recipe.method: Create 48 mock galaxy cubes using GALMOD in 3DBAROLO with exponential radial surface density, Gaussian vertical profile, empirical rotation curve, constant dispersion, synthetic beam convolution, and convolved random noise; fit total flux maps with CANNUBI MCMC to test recovery of centre, radial extent, inclination, and thickness
key_parameters: Mock grid: R = 3 kpc, V_t = 250 km s^-1, R_t = 1 kpc, beta = 0.4, xi = 2.5, sigma = 50 km s^-1, 3 or 5 resolution elements per side, SNR = 3 or 5, i = 30, 50, 70 deg, Z0 = 0, 0.2, 0.8, 1.6 kpc
assumptions: Circular orbits in tilted-ring model, radial exponential surface density profile, Gaussian vertical density profile, constant velocity dispersion of 50 km s^-1

recipe.goal: Estimate disc geometry (centre, radial extent, inclination, morphological PA, and thickness) of the observed galaxies
recipe.method: Run CANNUBI on the [CII] total flux maps assuming a razor-thin disc (Z0 = 0) for the fiducial models; also run CANNUBI in full 3D cube mode with PA fixed to morphological PA and inclination and thickness (Z0) free to test thick-disc effects
key_parameters: Fiducial run: Z0 = 0 (razor-thin disc), minimising on total flux map; Thick-disc run: full 3D cube mode, PA fixed to morphological PA, inclination and Z0 free
assumptions: Razor-thin disc (Z0 = 0) for fiducial models; constant disc thickness with radius for thick-disc test

recipe.goal: Fit 3D tilted-ring kinematic models to derive rotation curves and velocity dispersion profiles
recipe.method: Fit 3D tilted-ring models to the masked [CII] datacubes using 3DBAROLO with azimuthal surface density normalisation; derive kinematic PA using 2-stage regularisation (0th-order polynomial), then fix geometry (X0, Y0, INC, Z0=0, PA=PA_kin, except free PA for SGP38326-1) and fit VROT and VDISP in independent radial rings; repeat fit with thick-disc INC and Z0 values to assess systematic uncertainty
key_parameters: LINEAR = 0.43 (AzTEC1, BRI1335-0417), 0.51 (J081740, SGP38326-1, SGP38326-2); SIDE = approaching (BRI1335-0417), both (all others)
assumptions: Circular orbits with no large-scale radial or vertical motions; razor-thin disc (Z0 = 0) for fiducial fit; azimuthal surface density normalisation

recipe.goal: Classify galaxies as rotating discs vs mergers using the PVsplit diagram
recipe.method: Measure asymmetry parameters Pmajor, PV, and PR from major-axis p-v diagrams; compare in 3D PVsplit space against SERRA mock galaxies and WHISP local discs/mergers; compute linear SVM dividing plane with sklearn
key_parameters: SVM dividing plane: -0.63 P_major - 0.27 P_V + 2.78 P_R - 2.72 = 0
